In this context, this Master Circular is being issued aiming to create a single reference for all

check the fulfillment of the objectives of the regulations and monitoring of the performance /
working of the insurers.
Part - II of the circular are business statistics that are collected either through BAP / email.

distribution channels, demography, product segments, persistency, renewability, etc. It
provides greater insights into the company's business strategy.

subsequent to the notification of this circular.

Regulatory Returns.

understanding.
